Name: Azariah, Chief Priest
Role: Chief Priest of the House of Zadok
Summary: Azariah, chief priest of the house of Zadok, told Hezekiah that since the people began bringing offerings, they had enough and plenty left, for the LORD had blessed His people.
KeyStory: Azariah answered Hezekiah that the great store left over was because the LORD had blessed His people.
LifeLesson: Generous giving to the LORD leaves plenty, not scarcity.
